title: Call Handler
description:
Social Housing Call Handler

Location: Crawley
Salary: 17.00 per hour
Hours: 40 hours per week
Contract: Temporary to Permanent
Working Pattern: Fully Office Based

About the Role

We are currently recruiting for a Social Housing Call Handler to join a busy property services team based in Crawley.

This is a great opportunity for someone with strong customer service and communication skills who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment and wants to build a career within the social housing sector.

You will be the first point of contact for residents, dealing with enquiries and providing support across housing and property maintenance services.

Key Responsibilities
- Handle a high volume of inbound calls from residents and customers.
- Respond to queries relating to repairs, maintenance and housing services.
- Log and update repair requests accurately on internal systems.
- Book and coordinate appointments for repairs and property services.
- Liaise with residents, contractors and internal teams to resolve queries.
- Provide regular updates to residents regarding outstanding repairs and appointments.
- Deal with complaints and escalate issues where appropriate.
- Ensure all calls and customer interactions are recorded accurately.
- Provide a professional and helpful service at all times.
- Work as part of a wider property services and customer service team.

About You

The successful candidate will ideally have:
- Previous experience in a call centre, customer service or contact centre environment.
- Experience within social housing, property services, repairs or maintenance is highly desirable.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
- A confident and professional telephone manner.
- Strong organisational and administration skills.
- The ability to work under pressure in a busy environment.
- Good attention to detail and accurate data-entry skills.
- The ability to deal with difficult or challenging customers professionally.
- Good IT skills and confidence using internal systems.
- A positive, customer-focused approach.

title: Finance Assistant
description:
Finance Assistant - Primary School

Location: Crawley
Hours: 15 hours per week, over 2 or 3 days
Pay: 13- 16 per hour, depending on experience
Start Date: November

Are you an organised and detail-focused finance professional looking for a part-time opportunity within a supportive primary school environment?

A welcoming primary school in Crawley is seeking a reliable and experienced Finance Assistant to join their team from November. This is an excellent opportunity for a Finance Assistant who is looking for flexible part-time hours and enjoys working in an education setting.

The Role

As Finance Assistant, you will play an important role in supporting the school's day-to-day financial administration. You will work closely with the school's administrative team to ensure financial processes are accurate, efficient and well maintained.

The successful Finance Assistant will be responsible for a range of financial and administrative duties, including:
- Processing invoices and payments
- General finance administration and record keeping
- Providing wider administrative support to the school when required

About You

We are looking for a Finance Assistant who is organised, trustworthy and confident working with financial information.

The ideal candidate will have:
- Previous experience in a Finance Assistant or similar finance administration role
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy
- Good organisational and time-management skills
- Confidence using Microsoft Office, particularly Excel
- Excellent communication skills
- The ability to work independently and as part of a team
- A professional and approachable manner
- Ideally, previous experience working within a school or education environment, although this is not essential

What's on Offer
- Part-time hours of 15 hours per week over 2 or 3 days
- 13- 16 per hour, depending on experience
- Opportunity to work within a friendly and supportive primary school
- Convenient Crawley location
- Opportunity to contribute to the smooth running of a local school

If you are an experienced Finance Assistant seeking a part-time opportunity in Crawley, we would love to hear from you. This could be an ideal role for someone looking for flexibility while continuing to develop their finance experience within a supportive school environment.

Location: Crawley

To apply for this Finance Assistant position, please submit your CV for consideration.

This role is via Academics Recruitment Agency, acting on behalf of the school.

Salary will be determined by the successful candidate's qualifications and relevant experience, and will be in accordance with the client's pay policy.

title: HR & Payroll Administrator - Immediate Start
description:
HR & Payroll Coordinator - Immediate Start

Location: Crawley
Contract: Full-Time Temp
Salary: 17 - 19 PH PAYE

We are partnering with a well-established and highly respected organisation to recruit an experienced HR & Payroll Coordinator. This is a fantastic opportunity to join a busy and supportive team in a role that combines payroll administration with broader HR support responsibilities.

This position would suit a proactive individual who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment, takes pride in accuracy, and is confident managing payroll processes while supporting employees and managers across a range of HR activities.

Key Responsibilities
- Support the end-to-end monthly payroll process, ensuring all employee data is accurate and submitted within deadlines.
- Maintain payroll records including starters, leavers, contractual changes, salary amendments and benefits updates.
- Act as a key point of contact for payroll-related queries from employees and stakeholders.
- Coordinate employee benefits administration, including pension and salary sacrifice schemes.
- Assist with payroll year-end activities, including statutory reporting requirements.
- Assist with the preparation and administration of annual P11 D and PSA submissions, ensuring compliance with HMRC requirements and deadlines.
- Provide administrative support across the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, probation, contractual changes and offboarding.
- Maintain the HR system and employee records, ensuring accuracy and compliance.
- Produce HR and payroll reports as required.
- Support HR initiatives, projects and general employee relations administration.

About You
- Previous experience in a payroll and/or HR administration role.
- Experience supporting P11 D, PSA and employee benefits administration.
- Strong understanding of payroll processes and associated legislation.
- Previous experience working with payroll systems such as ADP or similar would be advantageous.
- Excellent attention to detail with a high level of accuracy.
- Confident using HR and payroll systems.
- Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel.
- Ability to manage confidential information with discretion and professionalism.
- Excellent organisational and communication skills.
- Able to prioritise a varied workload and work effectively to deadlines.

What's on Offer?
- Friendly and collaborative working environment.
- Hybrid working arrangements.
- Varied role with exposure to both payroll and HR functions.

If you are an experienced HR and Payroll professional looking for your next opportunity and enjoy delivering a high-quality service in a busy environment, we would love to hear from you.

title: Sales Executive
description:
Sales Executive

Hays Collections Ltd Crawley
£26,000 £30,000 per annum, depending on experience + Bonus
Monday to Friday 9:00am 5:30pm
Office-based

Hays Collections Ltd is a growing B2 B debt recovery business based in Surrey, supporting companies across the UK with the recovery of unpaid invoices and commercial debts.

As we continue to expand, we are looking to recruit a motivated and confident Sales Executive to join our team.

This is a varied role focused on supporting the continued growth of the business through new client acquisition, outbound business development and the management of inbound enquiries.

The Role

As a Sales Executive, you will be responsible for identifying and engaging with businesses that may benefit from our services, while also supporting the wider sales team with new business opportunities.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Proactively contacting prospective clients through telephone, email, LinkedIn and other outreach channels
- Identifying new business opportunities and generating qualified leads
- Speaking with business owners, directors and finance professionals
- Managing and responding to inbound sales enquiries
- Following up with prospective clients and maintaining strong relationships
- Clearly explaining our services, fee structure and debt recovery process
- Supporting the wider sales team with business development activity
- Maintaining accurate records of leads, conversations and follow-up activity
- Working closely with our collections team to understand client requirements and suitable opportunities

We are looking for someone who is confident, professional and comfortable communicating with businesses at all levels.

Previous experience within sales, business development or a B2 B environment would be advantageous.

Experience or knowledge of the construction industry, trade sector or businesses operating within construction and associated trades would be particularly beneficial, as a significant proportion of our client base operates within these industries.

The successful candidate will ideally be:
- Confident communicating with business owners, directors and senior decision-makers
- Comfortable with outbound prospecting and telephone-based business development
- Proactive and motivated to generate new opportunities
- Professional, personable and able to build strong relationships
- Organised with excellent follow-up skills
- Comfortable working towards individual and team targets
- A strong verbal and written communicator
- Able to work effectively as part of a close-knit team

Why Join Hays Collections?

Hays Collections is an ambitious and fast-growing business with a supportive and social team environment.

You will receive ongoing support and training from the wider team, with the opportunity to develop your knowledge of both sales and the commercial debt recovery industry.

As the company continues to grow, there will also be opportunities for progression and increased responsibility for the right person.

Salary: £26,000 £30,000 per annum, depending on experience
Bonus: Performance-related bonus in addition to basic salary
Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00am 5:30pm
Location: Crawley office based

If you are a motivated sales professional looking to join a growing business where you can make a genuine contribution to its continued expansion, we would be pleased to hear from you.
